site.title: YULA Lab — We design tomorrow's products today.
site.description: YULA Lab develops its own products and offers AI consulting: from workflow assessment to prototypes, integrations and evaluation.

footer.tagline: An independent product lab that uses AI in the right place at the right time, without overstating it.

landing.heroDescription: YULA Lab is an independent product lab that designs AI-native, data-driven products that simplify everyday life. Every project is built at the intersection of aesthetics, ethics, and impact.
landing.visionBody: Tools that run on your own data can run without handing that data to anyone. YULA Lab exists to show this is possible not only technically, but commercially.
landing.missionBody: Every product ships with a measurable claim, and the number stays on the page whether it flatters us or not. Users know what they are getting — and what they are not.
landing.manifestoNote: An engineering culture built on four values.
landing.heroEyebrow: A one-person AI product lab · Türkiye
landing.heroTitleB: Thought about for a long time.
landing.heroLede: YULA Lab develops its own products and offers AI consulting: from workflow assessment to prototypes, integrations and evaluation.
landing.visionTitle: The default for personal software should be the device, not the cloud.
landing.missionTitle: Ship few products, and measure what they claim.
landing.value1Body: The hit rate and the error margin sit on the same page. The backtest method is public.
landing.value2Body: Fewer features, properly finished. Everything we don't add is maintenance debt we don't carry.
landing.value3Body: Data stays on the device by default. Data that never reaches a server cannot leak from one.
landing.value4Body: A model's output has to be explainable. Decision rationale is not hidden from the user.
landing.manifestoNoteNew: Six principles. Each one is practised or it isn't written down.
landing.m1Title: The data belongs to the user.
landing.m1Body: On-device is the default. The cloud can be a convenience; it cannot be a condition. Data we never collect is data we never have to promise to protect.
landing.m2Title: We don't claim what we haven't measured.
landing.m2Body: If we state a number, how it was measured is stated too. A hidden method makes the result untrustworthy — our own products included.
landing.m3Body: Three features that work flawlessly beat ten that are half done. Refusing to add something is a design decision too.
landing.m4Body: If a model gives an answer, its reasoning has to be visible. A black box is our shortcoming, not the user's problem.
landing.m5Title: We don't show what doesn't exist.
landing.m5Body: No mockups of interfaces that aren't ready. A product card may stand without an image; it may not stand on a fabricated one.
landing.m6Body: Shipped because it's ready, not because of a date. We don't grow a product until we're sure we can sustain it.
landing.visualsNote: Interface still settling · visuals on the product page
landing.transparencyTitleB: The numbers are measurement, not marketing.
landing.transparencyBody: How every claim was measured is written down; a hidden method makes the result untrustworthy. Where the models get it wrong stays on the same page.
landing.closingBody: The next product is in the works. Partnership, a technical question, or plain curiosity — write briefly, get a brief reply.

manifesto.title: With craft, not haste.
manifesto.intro: YULA Lab is an independent product lab that leans on evidence, not trends. Each of our products is a different face of the same discipline: making a measurable difference in human life through restrained, transparent design.
manifesto.nameTitle: Yula: a light that shows the way.
manifesto.nameBody: Yula is the word for a small, steady light that guides you through the dark. Lab is its counterpart — a discipline of experiment, measurement, repetition. Put together, that's the whole method: warmth without excess, guidance without spectacle.

projectsIndex.title: The family.
projectsIndex.intro: Eight products, one discipline. Each speaks its own design language; underneath, the same engineering culture, the same transparency, the same calm user experience.
projectsIndex.shippedNote: Products with a previous publication or beta record. Cards flag availability that needs re-verification; dated sources and links are on each product page.
projectsIndex.researchNote: Not released yet: no store pages, no download links, no verified numbers. They are kept separate below because giving them the same weight as shipped products would make them look like more than they are.

transparency.title: No black boxes. Ever.
transparency.intro: At YULA Lab, transparency isn't a feature — it's the default. Every product makes the same promise: the model, the cost and the data are visible to you. You are using an AI product; you should not have to close your eyes.
transparency.promiseBody: Every decision you take, every token you spend, every row we store — you can see it. Nothing ships unless we can explain it.
transparency.pillarsEyebrow: Three core products, three transparency mechanics
transparency.pillarsTitle: We don't claim it — we prove it.

braavolabs.label: Transparent cost
braavolabs.title: Every agent, every token, every second.
braavolabs.claim: Every pipeline run shows which agent called which tool, how many tokens it spent and which decision it cost — in plain view. No surprise bills.
braavolabs.proof: → Primitives · providers · dated evidence on the product page
braavolabs.detailBody: Every tool call and decision is a separate row; money-touching actions require an explicit human approval. Export the full run as CSV / JSON and reconcile against your own accounting.

burunfarki.label: Open methodology
burunfarki.title: Top 3 factors for every prediction.
burunfarki.claim: We don't hide why the model picked that horse. A rule-based weighting shows the top 3 factors in race-specific language.
burunfarki.proof: → burunfark.com/dogruluk · dated measurement summary on the product page
burunfarki.detailBody: The live tracking panel includes winning and missed predictions together. Read results alongside their measurement date, race coverage and breakdowns by track, course and distance.

lifeos.label: On-device privacy
lifeos.title: On-device storage, optional sync.
lifeos.claim: Personal records are encrypted on-device with SQLCipher and AES-256. AI tasks using the local model run on-device; cloud sync is optional.
lifeos.detailBody: Local AI requires a supported device and an installed model. Model downloads, account and store operations, and crash reporting you enable are separate network paths from sync. The LifeOS privacy policy explains these options.

dataOwnership.title: Your data belongs to you.
dataOwnership.body: The scope of export and deletion tools varies by product and version. Deleting device data is separate from deleting account and server-side records. See the product's privacy policy for available tools and retention information; send requests about account and server-side records to support@yulalab.com.

noTraining.title: Your data is not used for model training.
noTraining.body: We do not derive models from customer content. With BYOK your data goes to the provider you chose; we are a router, not a backup.

noAds.title: No ads, no tracking.
noAds.body: Our only revenue model is paying users. We don't harvest your data to resell it; analytics is minimal and consent-gated.

exitRight.title: The exit door is always open.
exitRight.body: Canceling a subscription, deleting an account and removing device data are separate actions. To cancel, use subscription management in the store or service where you purchased. See the product's privacy policy for export and deletion steps; contact support@yulalab.com for help.

transparency.ctaTitle: We're open to deeper technical conversation.

contact.title: Let's talk.
contact.intro: An idea, a piece of feedback, a press request, or just hello — email is the fastest way to reach us. We usually reply within 48 hours.
contact.generalHint: Contact us for product support, technical questions, partnerships, and press inquiries.
contact.pressHint: Interviews, event invitations and press release requests.
contact.studioBody: The address on this page is for general correspondence. If you have a project in mind, the studio application is faster: it asks for budget band, timing and who decides, so the first reply is not spent asking those three questions.
contact.studioTitle: Writing about a piece of work?

notes.title: What we did, as it happened.
notes.intro: Transparency applies here too — short, honest notes on what changed, what got fixed, what came alive in our products.

lifeos.lede: An offline-first personal life operating system. Five life domains gathered into one calm interface, with records encrypted on the device using AES-256. Cloud sync is optional.
lifeos.a1Body: Notes, habits, plans and records don't scatter across separate apps. LifeOS gathers them into a single calm view where the state of each domain is visible without crowding the screen.
lifeos.a2Title: Your daily records are available offline.
lifeos.a2Body: Your data is stored on-device; sync is optional. Model downloads, account and store operations, and crash reporting you enable may use the internet independently of the sync setting.
lifeos.interfaceNote: No screenshots published until the interface settles. We don't draw a screen that doesn't exist.
lifeos.ctaBody: No account needed after install. Trying it and deleting it is a legitimate outcome too.

burunfarki.lede: A transparent AI horse-racing analysis platform. Model rankings, their reasoning and past results appear together. Explore the dated performance records and measurement scope in the evidence section below. Development is currently on hold; this page does not promise a new release or current store availability.
burunfarki.a1Title: It reads the race; it doesn't hand you a slip.
burunfarki.a1Body: The platform takes a race's data and shows the model's ranking along with the factors that produced it. It generates no odds, recommends no bets, guarantees nothing. The decision is the user's.
burunfarki.a2Title: Every prediction comes with its reasoning.
burunfarki.a2Body: Rule-based contribution factors are listed per horse: which variable pushed the ranking up, which pushed it down. When the model returns something you dislike, you can see why.
burunfarki.r4v: Results are never revised after the fact
burunfarki.note: The backtest runs on later-dated races the model never saw in training. Excluded races and the data range are listed in the method note.
burunfarki.interfaceNote: Real screenshots are captured from production, never redrawn.
burunfarki.ctaBody: Check access through the Burun Farkı link, or send your questions by email.
burunfarki.disclaimer: Burun Farkı is not a betting product and does not broker bets. Past performance is no guarantee of future results.

braavolabs.lede: An agent and automation command centre. Reusable primitives, multiple LLM providers and a ledger of run costs. Explore provider and primitive counts in the dated evidence section.
braavolabs.a1Body: Automations are built from a handful of building blocks rather than canned templates. Each block does one job; the flow emerges from how they're arranged, and stays readable.
braavolabs.a2Body: How many tokens each run spent with which provider — and what that came to — sits in the ledger. Switching provider is a setting, not a rewrite.
braavolabs.interfaceNote: Real screenshots are captured from the beta build.
braavolabs.ctaTitle: The beta moves by closed invite.
braavolabs.ctaBody: Check product access through Braavolabs, or ask about setup and usage by email.

gravita.lede: Gravita's first release focuses on a foundation course for handstand and bodyweight skills. Reading, practice and self-reported progress are saved on the device; no camera skill score or mastery certification is produced. Camera coaching and paid sales are disabled in the first release.
gravita.a1Body: Work through reading and practice steps. The course does not require camera or microphone permission.
gravita.a2Body: Reading, practice and completion are separate records. Self-reported progress stays on the device; it is not a camera skill score or mastery certification.
gravita.note: Camera coaching and paid sales are disabled in the first release. Course progress is not synced to your Motion account.
gravita.interfaceNote: The product is still in development; we don't draw a screen that doesn't exist. Real captures land here once the interface settles.
gravita.ctaBody: Gravita is currently in development. Write to us if you'd like to hear when it launches.
gravita.disclaimer: Gravita is not a medical device and does not diagnose injuries. As a movement-skills coach, it doesn't replace a real trainer.

ostinato.lede: Ostinato's first release focuses on a guitar course and on-device, self-reported progress. You can choose to start single-note observation and grant microphone permission; audio is processed only in temporary device memory, never recorded or uploaded. Observation does not produce a correctness or mastery score; the course can be completed without the microphone. Camera coaching and paid sales are disabled in the first release.
ostinato.a1Body: The course offers reading, practice and self-reported progress steps. It does not require camera permission and can be completed without the microphone.
ostinato.a2Body: You start observation and grant operating-system microphone permission. The approximate note display does not score chords, timing, correctness or mastery; it does not complete a lesson.
ostinato.r2v: Approximate single note · no technique score
ostinato.note: Audio is processed only in temporary device memory; raw audio files are not recorded or uploaded. Leaving the screen, changing account or moving to the background stops the microphone; returning does not restart it. Camera coaching and paid sales are disabled in the first release.
ostinato.interfaceNote: The product is still in development; we don't draw a screen that doesn't exist. Real captures land here once the interface settles.
ostinato.ctaBody: Ostinato is currently in development. Write to us if you'd like to hear when it launches.
ostinato.disclaimer: Ostinato does not replace a music teacher; the course and optional note observation do not certify technique correctness or mastery.

studio.intro: The discipline we hold our own products to, applied to yours: every claim sourced, every figure dated, everything stale visibly stale.
studio.noPromiseBody: We do not guarantee an outcome — we publish what the measurement says, including when we dislike it. We do not provide capital or investment. We have not yet completed an engagement for an outside client, and we would rather write that here than leave it out.
notFor: An idea without a product — there is nothing here to verify yet
Anyone looking for investment; YULA does the work, it does not write cheques
Anyone who wants a report whose conclusion is already written
Anyone who does not want to hear what the measurement says

studio.title: Build with YULA.

consulting.title: Make AI useful in your business.
consulting.intro: From a specific business problem to a testable prototype and a maintainable integration. We help teams decide where AI adds value, build the right workflow, and measure its limits.

services.title: AI opportunity assessment
services.body: Map a workflow, its data and constraints. Compare AI with simpler alternatives before committing to a build.
services.output: Deliverable: prioritized use cases, feasibility notes and a scoped implementation plan.

services.title: Prototypes and integrations
services.body: Build a focused assistant, knowledge search or workflow automation around your existing tools. Define human review and failure handling.
services.output: Deliverable: a working prototype, evaluation cases and integration documentation.

services.title: Evaluation and engineering review
services.body: Review model outputs, data handling, reliability and operating cost against agreed criteria.
services.output: Deliverable: findings, reproducible checks and a prioritized improvement plan.

consulting.processTitle: A clear scope before a build
steps: Discovery: describe the problem, current workflow and constraints.
Scope: agree the deliverables, access boundaries, acceptance criteria and commercial terms in writing.
Build and evaluate: test a focused solution against representative cases.
Handover: document operation, known limits and the next decision.
consulting.proofTitle: Our own products are the starting point.
consulting.proofBody: Our portfolio shows the products we build and their documented development and publication status. It is our own engineering work, not a list of client engagements.
consulting.limits: We do not promise a revenue increase, perfect model output or a release date before discovery. Production access and deployment require a separate agreement.
consulting.contactTitle: Tell us what you want to improve.
consulting.contactBody: Start with your workflow, the problem and your timeline. Do not send passwords, API keys or confidential customer data. The email link opens your mail app; nothing is submitted by this page.
consulting.subject: AI consulting enquiry
consulting.terms: Availability, pricing and scope are confirmed in conversation.
